<!-- pr-reviewer: 14e01be8494719a3337bfd2dbdc3a60f4883b025 -->
**Ready for the maintainer to merge.**

This review read head `14e01be84`. The trial merge with current `origin/main` is clean. I built and tested locally in `.claude/worktrees/pr-3598-review`.

## What looks good

- The rename is one constant, `posting::agie::POST` (`crates/app/src/posting_agie.rs:18`). The old name is one hidden alias, `LEGACY_POST` (`crates/app/src/posting_agie.rs:22`). No list shows the alias.
- The alias resolves at each place a name enters: `SelectPost` (`commands/post.rs:32`), `SetSetupPost` (`commands/setup_mount.rs:137`), the project file (`project/apply.rs:718`, `project/mount_dto.rs:70`), the option keys (`schema.rs:640`), `resolve_cps` (`posting.rs:443`), the machine-file check (`machine/validate.rs:385`) and the post offer (`posting_offer.rs:46`). `agie::is_native` accepts both names (`posting_agie.rs:51`).
- The saved project and the world keep one spelling. The new test pins it: open an old file, get the new name, and save the new name only (`crates/app/tests/wire_post_alias.rs`).
- The `.refusal` goldens change only line 2, the `.cps` throw text at `assets/posts/agie-native.cps:16`. The error position `user.cps:16:9` is the same. No `.nc`, controller-file or snapshot PNG changed.
- `Process change: yes` is in the body. The PR does not edit `.claude/PROCESS_VERSION`. The body has a `Changelog:` line and ends `Fixes #3537`.
- The new test file is 101 lines. Its Gate map names `app::posting::agie`, `app::project` and `app::commands::SelectPost`. No `unwrap`, `expect` or `panic!` was added in non-test code.

## Results merged with main (locally)

- `cargo test -p camcraft-app`: `wire_post_alias` 4 passed, `agie_native` 11 passed, `conformance` 7 passed, `mcp_wire_contour` 8 passed, `plasma_post_refusals` 7 passed, `mcp_doc_drift` 6 passed. 0 failed.
- `cargo test -p camcraft-post`: `script_agie_native` 11 passed, `comment_escape` 4 passed. 0 failed.
- `cargo test -p camcraft-ui --lib -- native_post_dialog` (CWD `crates/ui`): 3 passed. 0 failed.
- `cargo clippy -p camcraft-app -p camcraft-post -p camcraft-ui --all-targets -- -D warnings`: clean.
- Build: the test profiles build with no error.

## Targeted tests

- No post output or toolpath changes. Only refusal, UI and metadata text changes, plus the alias logic.
- Light lane `cargo xtask gate light`: 3 steps, 0 failed (light build 258s, `motion light: lib`, `motion light: adaptive_troch_parallel`).
- No heavy lane. This is a `P3` change, not under the safety floor.
- The example catalog suites were not run here. The diff changes no posted program, and the author reports `example_catalog`, `example_catalog_adaptive` and `example_catalog_edge_work` green on this head.

## Requested before merge

None.

## Questions / notes (not blocking)

- `crates/app/src/script/report.rs:81` keeps the script receipt value `"Agie native wire EDM"`. The decision file explains why (a script reads it; a change is breaking). This is correct, but a future reader may wonder why one old name stays.
- The body says no test loads a `.mch` file that states the old `controller.post`. The code path (`machine/validate.rs:385`, `posting_offer.rs:46`) handles it, but a test with a real old-name machine file would lock it.
- `crates/app/src/schema.rs` grows by 14 lines and is already over 400 lines. The growth is small and the file is the schema home, so this is not a defect.

A maintainer will approve and merge by hand.
